title: Turkish-Style Fennel and Kisir Salad
description: A refreshing and flavorful salad inspired by Turkish cuisine, featuring crunchy fennel and kisir.

ingredients.name: vibrant
ingredients.amount: 1/4 cup, chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley, dill, or mint)

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sliced fennel and crumbled kisir.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and olive oil.
Season the dressing with salt to taste.
Pour the dressing over the fennel and kisir mixture, and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the chopped vibrant herbs over the salad, and toss again to distribute evenly.
Serve the salad chilled, garnished with additional herbs if desired.
